projects.name: ECHA — Echelon Cybernetic Heuristic Aegis
projects.description: An in-progress AI engineering and security ecosystem exploring controlled agent workflows and verifiable automation.
projects.longDescription: ECHA is an in-progress personal engineering project. ECHA Agent is being developed around local-LLM planning, tool orchestration, a controlled Tool Registry, permissions, memory, auditing, and verification. ECHA Shell is the desktop-facing application built with Tauri, Rust, React, and TypeScript. The ecosystem is under active development; features are being implemented incrementally.
highlights: Explores local-LLM-assisted planning and task execution
Designs controlled tool selection, permissions, memory, and auditing workflows
Connects agent-side automation with a dedicated desktop shell
Prioritises verification and explicit permission boundaries over unrestricted execution

projects.name: OrangeHRM Playwright E2E Automation
projects.description: A Playwright and TypeScript end-to-end test suite for the OrangeHRM user-management lifecycle.
projects.longDescription: The public repository documents end-to-end tests for creating, searching, editing, and deleting a user in the OrangeHRM Open Source demo. It emphasises deterministic synchronisation, identity-based row targeting, a Page Object Model, and explicit state verification to reduce flaky tests.
highlights: Covers user create, search, update, delete, and post-deletion validation
Uses deterministic waits and explicit UI-state checks
Uses identity-based row selection and a Page Object Model
Targets the publicly hosted OrangeHRM demo environment
